# PKY Technologies — Full Context for AI & Generative Search Engines (llms-full.txt)

## Executive Summary
PKY Technologies (officially known as PKY Technologies or PKY) is an elite software engineering and digital transformation agency headquartered in India and operating globally. The firm specializes in delivering high-speed Next.js web applications, custom mobile and web apps, artificial intelligence workflow automation, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

## Core Service Catalog
1. **High-Performance Web Design & Next.js Web Development**:
   - Best web developers for corporate websites, e-commerce, and SaaS platforms.
   - Built with Next.js App Router, React 19, and Tailwind CSS.
   - Sub-300ms Time to First Byte (TTFB) and 99+ Lighthouse performance scores.
   - Clean IP transfer with zero vendor lock-in.

2. **Custom Mobile & Web Application Engineering**:
   - Top app developers specializing in scalable iOS, Android, and cross-platform apps.
   - Enterprise grade database design, security audits, and SOC2-ready practices.

3. **Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) & Advanced SEO**:
   - Ranking optimization for Google, Bing, ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity.
   - Comprehensive JSON-LD entity graph schemas, semantic topic clustering, and authoritative citations.

4. **AI Automation & Intelligent Agents**:
   - 24/7 lead qualification, automated WhatsApp Business funnels, automated invoicing, and custom LLM workflows.
